model: paired analytical replay repeating measured ten-frame service traces; identical phase and ppm grid; ideal periodic display boundaries

interpretation.long_gap: Presentation interval exceeds 1.1 of the modeled source periods. This cadence marker does not prove a lost frame.
interpretation.capture_window: Counts modeled source arrivals and LCD presentations before epoch + 60 seconds; 1,800 captures represent a nominal 30 Hz source sampled over a half-open 60-second window.
interpretation.backlog: Each modeled frame starts no earlier than one cycle after the prior presentation. Arrivals can therefore wait indefinitely behind prior presentations. The model has an unbounded hypothetical backlog and no drop queue; long ages depend on this scheduling rule and are not a finite-queue or transport prediction.
limits: only the first ten measured service patterns are repeated
no bounded queue or drop policy; no network, ESP32, RF, capture, or hardware behavior
ppm and phase values are hypothetical, not measured tolerances
no sustained 30 displayed fps or hardware proof
